feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 31 May 2026 9:59pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 31 May 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Complex areas of low pressure to the west of Ireland driving various frontal zones across the area tomorrow.


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 overnight and increasing 6 in central areas at times.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building mainly moderate during tomorrow.


##Weather##

Fair to start, then occasional rain or drizzle approaching from the west overnight. Areas of mist soon developing, with isolated fog patches.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor overnight and falling very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 2 to 4 overnight into Tuesday and falling variable in places. Settling west or southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate becoming slight overnight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or showers becoming isolated later. Areas of mist and isolated fog patches at first.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor, falling very poor in fog patches, then becoming good but moderate in rain or showers.
